summary: The user reports purchasing a laptop for Rs. 60,000 from an online marketplace and receiving it with a broken screen. The seller has refused replacement or refund. legal_position: A product delivered with physical damage may raise a consumer grievance concerning defective goods and/or the seller's or marketplace's handling of the complaint. Whether the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 or other remedies apply to the particular facts requires review of the transaction, seller details, evidence and applicable terms. This preliminary assessment is not a legal finding.
possible_actions: Preserve the invoice, order confirmation, payment proof and delivery records.
Take clear photographs and a short video showing the damaged screen and the laptop's condition.
Send a written complaint to the seller and marketplace, requesting a replacement or refund and keeping the ticket number.
Review the marketplace's return and replacement policy and the product warranty.
If the grievance remains unresolved, consider registering it with the National Consumer Helpline at https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/.
Consider obtaining advice from a qualified lawyer if the dispute is not resolved or formal proceedings are being considered.
evidence_required: Payment receipt or bank/card statement showing the transaction.
Copies of emails, chat transcripts and complaint ticket numbers.
Applicable return policy and warranty documents.

complaint_draft:
To,
The Customer Grievance Redressal Officer,
[Marketplace / Seller Name]

Subject: Complaint regarding delivery of a laptop with a broken screen

Dear Sir/Madam,

I purchased a laptop for Rs. 60,000 through your platform. The order ID is [Order ID], and the purchase/delivery date was [Date]. On receiving the product, I found that its screen was broken.

I contacted [Seller / Marketplace] on [Date(s)] through [Email / Chat / Phone] and requested a replacement or refund. However, my request was refused. The relevant invoice, photographs and communication records are available and can be provided for review.

I request that you investigate this complaint and provide an appropriate resolution, preferably a replacement with a product in proper condition or a refund of the amount paid. Please provide a written response and complaint reference number.

Regards,
[Your Name]
[Contact Details]
[Email Address]
